meaning_en: A source-contact and freshness marker. It means the underlying primary record has been actively checked, dependencies have been revisited and unresolved points remain visible.
meaning_es: Un marcador de contacto con la fuente y de vigencia. Significa que se ha contrastado activamente el registro primario, se han revisado sus dependencias y siguen visibles los puntos no resueltos.
boundary_en: This is a forensic metaphor, not a physiological lie detector. It does not infer fear, truthfulness, intent, credibility, criminality, guilt or liability from a human pulse or gesture.
boundary_es: Es una metáfora forense, no un detector fisiológico de mentiras. No infiere miedo, veracidad, intención, credibilidad, criminalidad, culpabilidad ni responsabilidad a partir del pulso o de un gesto humano.

relationship.the_pulse: make contact with the primary record and establish current evidential state
relationship.truth_machine: test the proposition against identified evidence
